name: likeclusters
title: likeclusters
blurb: paste a handle and likeclusters reads that account's entire post history, pulls each one's public likers, extracts a rough keyword/hashtag topic per post, and groups the likers by which topic they actually show up for — click any topic tag to mark it annoying and it flags the moots who only ever show up for that one thing. @fromthewestmeadow.com asked for a way to see which of your moots likes which topic cluster, then again to flag which of those clusters annoy you, then again to sample the whole archive instead of just 60 posts, then again to read every liker on every post instead of stopping at 200.
